Treatment summary
Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of right knee pain, swelling, and limited range of
motion. The mechanism of injury described is consistent with the knee trauma observed, and the presenting complaints are
plausible for a collision of this type. Initial examination documented effusion and tenderness along the medial joint line, and
subsequent imaging findings clearly confirm the injury. No prior injury or treatment involving the same body area is known to
this provider or reported by the patient.
Care was delivered over eleven visits and consisted of physical therapy, activity modification, and anti-inflammatory medication
management. Treatment followed a typical course of recovery, with visit frequency decreasing as strength, range of motion, and
pain levels improved. At discharge the patient was ambulating without assistance and had returned to most daily activities.
Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no repeated or duplicate entries.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
